Magic Mouse Vertikale Ladestation & Display-Ständer

### 🍎 Vertical Charging Dock for Apple Magic Mouse ⚡

✨ Finally, a stylish solution for the Magic Mouse's infamous charging design! ✨

We all know charging the Magic Mouse is... awkward. Stop flipping it over on your desk like a &#34;dead beetle.&#34; This minimalist dock solves the problem by holding your mouse upright, turning it into a sleek display piece while it juices up. It’s the accessory Apple should have made. 🔋🖥️

### 🌟 Key Features

* 🎯 No More &#34;Dead Bug&#34; Mode: Holds the mouse securely in a vertical position, allowing the Lightning cable to plug in underneath while displaying the device beautifully.
* 🧘♂️ Minimalist Aesthetic: The clean curves match the Magic Mouse perfectly, making it look right at home next to your iMac, Mac Studio, or MacBook setup.
* ⚖️ Stable & Secure: The widened base ensures the dock doesn't tip over easily when the mouse is seated.

### ⚙️ Print Settings (Super Easy!)

This model is designed to be simple to print with no fuss.

* ✅ Supports: NO SUPPORTS NEEDED! Just print it flat on its base.
* 🧱 Material: PLA is perfect. (Tip: Matte White or Matte Grey PLA looks incredible and matches the Apple ecosystem very well).
* 📏 Layer Height: 0.20mm (Standard quality works great).
* 🕸️ Infill: 15% - 20% (Grid or Gyroid pattern is sufficient).
📸 Show off your workspace! I’d love to see how this looks on your desk. Please share a photo of your make!

Happy Printing! 🖨️🍏

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#000000)
